problem: Developing a sequence-to-sequence learning method for neural networks
method: Using a multilayered Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture for end-to-end learning
key_result: Achieving a BLEU score of 34.8 on an English-to-French translation task
one_liner: This paper presents a sequence-to-sequence learning method using neural networks that outperforms state-of-the-art machine translation systems.
